en: Black‑and‑white image of a large, light‑colored manor‑like building with a steep, tiled roof and simple neo‑classical/Scandinavian revival details. A tall flagpole with a Nordic-style flag (dark with a light cross) stands in front of the central gable. The foreground is filled with an orderly garden or orchard and a straight path leading toward the entrance. No printed captions or handwritten text are visible.
